scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun build apps/api/src/index.ts --target=bun --packages=external --outdir=apps/api/dist
scripts.test: bun run test:api && bun run test:web
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tests *.json *.ts docker/*.ts docker-compose.yml compose.docker.yml README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages tests *.json *.ts docker/*.ts docker-compose.yml compose.docker.yml README.md
